en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with a large ornate fountain in the foreground, topped by a standing statue and surrounded by sculpted lions and basins. Around the square are market stalls and people in early‑20th‑century dress. Behind them stand multi‑storey historic buildings with steep tiled roofs and shop signs in German, including a prominent wine shop. Tall church towers rise in the background.
